content: Command started in background; job_id=<job-1>. This durable job keeps running without this ChatGPT turn. Unless the user explicitly asked you to wait for completion, report the job_id and current progress and return control instead of polling repeatedly; the user can ask for status later. Suggest a check-back interval only when grounded in the task or observed progress. Use job_status for a later update, or stop_job to cancel.
